title: fix(spec)!: refuse an object's `external` binding on a managed datasource (ADR-0015 §4.2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6zwDuV2XvoDkqC7bXgqnpc)_

Fixes #25168

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

## What

ADR-0015 §4.2 allows `object.external` only on a datasource whose `schemaMode` is not `'managed'`, and declares the rule "enforced at metadata-load time". No load door enforced it. This PR makes the spec judge it, once, through one predicate (`packages/spec/src/data/external-binding-datasource.ts`, internal), at each door that can see the halves it needs. This follows the route in triage comment 6333828054: a declaration rule at the parse, inherited by the save door and `os validate`, and no second check in `packages/objectql`.

| The object's `datasource` | Where it is judged | Answer now |
|---|---|---|
| omitted or `'default'` (the primary, managed by construction) | `ObjectSchema`'s parse (superRefine), at `external` | `ObjectSchema.create` throws at module load. `defineStack` and `os validate` give `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` (422) at `objects.N.external`. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/NAME` gives `422 INVALID_METADATA` with the finding at `external`, and nothing is stored. |
| a datasource the same stack declares with `schemaMode: 'managed'` or with no `schemaMode` | `defineStack`'s cross-reference pass (`validateCrossReferences`) | `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` (422), one finding per bound object. `os validate` and `os build` inherit it. |
| a datasource declared `schemaMode: 'external'` or `'validate-only'` | (both doors) | accepted, as before |
| a datasource the stack does not declare | no door can see its `schemaMode` | no verdict, as before (see Acceptance notes) |

A package `defaultDatasource` or a `datasourceMapping` rule does not count as the object's datasource. They route queries, while the boot validation (`validateObjectUsing`) and the write gate (`assertWriteAllowed`) read only the object's own `datasource`. The refusal message says so.

ADR-0087 kit: the semantic entry `object-external-binding-managed-datasource-refused` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`), and a `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` detector that lists each stored object in the refused shape for `os migrate meta --stored` (no lossless rewrite: dropping `external` would turn the remote table into one ObjectStack creates). The changeset carries the `registered` disposition, `minor`, BREAKING with FROM and TO, and the one-line fix.

## Measured on the base (b6e870707), before any edit

- `defineStack` accepted all six probe stacks: datasource omitted, `'default'`, declared `managed`, declared with no `schemaMode`, declared `external` (control), and undeclared.
- `os validate` answered `valid: true`, exit 0, for both a declared-`managed` and a no-`schemaMode` datasource. This was the card's first NOT MEASURED reading.
- The object save door stored all three probes (datasource omitted, `'default'`, and a stored managed datasource named `wh`) and answered success. Each save logged the platform's own "published but its storage was NOT created" warning. This was the card's second NOT MEASURED reading.

## After this PR (same probes)

- `defineStack`: managed and no-`schemaMode` give `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` 422. Omitted and `'default'` give `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` 422. The `external` control and the undeclared datasource are accepted.
- `os validate`: exit 1, `valid: false`, with those codes and messages.
- Save door: `422 INVALID_METADATA` at `external` for omitted and `'default'`, and nothing is stored. A named stored datasource still saves; see Acceptance notes.

## Producers (the stop condition)

- In the repo, outside tests and including `examples/**`, the only object with `external` is the showcase's, and it is compliant: `showcase_external` is declared `schemaMode: 'external'`.
- Templates, CLI scaffolds and published skills have none.
- The Sync/import producer is gone since #25167, which was already merged when this branch was cut.
- HotCRM at c8a7a7047 has none.

No producer was found, so no conversion question applies.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/data/external-binding-datasource.test.ts`: the parse refuses at `['external']` (code `custom`) for datasource omitted, `'default'`, and an empty binding. `ObjectSchema.create` throws with the same issue. Controls and the predicate's unit cases.
- `packages/spec/src/stack-external-binding-datasource.test.ts`: `code` + `status` for both stack verdicts, one finding per bound object, the `external` and `validate-only` controls, an undeclared datasource accepted, `strict: false` skips, and a manifest `defaultDatasource` does not count.
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.test.ts`: the stored-row detector lists each object.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.external-binding-primary-datasource-refusal.test.ts`: the save door answers `INVALID_METADATA` 422, issues at `external`, and stores nothing; controls save.
- `packages/spec/src/data/object-strictness-batch20.test.ts`: four fixtures bound `external` with no datasource. They now name their federated datasource (`remote_crm`), per fixture triage (add the missing declaration).

Ablation, one time, on 488c2fe49:
- The mutation made the predicate answer nothing, which drops all three halves at once. It was checked on disk (grep of the injected text in the source, and in 12 built `.mjs` files), and `@objectstack/spec` was rebuilt.
- Under the mutation, the three spec files went red, 16 failed of 76, and the save-door file went red, 2 failed of 4 (exactly the two refusal cases).
- The source was restored with `git checkout HEAD`, and the restore was proved by comparing blob hashes (equal to HEAD) and by an empty `git diff HEAD`. `@objectstack/spec` was then rebuilt with declarations, and the mutation is in 0 dist files.
- After the restore, the spec files pass 76 of 76 and the save-door file passes 4 of 4.

Full `@objectstack/spec` suite on 03234e2d: 780 files passed and 1 skipped; 22737 tests passed, 1 skipped, 1 todo. The next commit, 488c2fe49, only narrows the assertions in two of the new test files, and those files pass 76 of 76 on it.

## Acceptance notes

- **The save door cannot see a named datasource's `schemaMode`.** `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/NAME` with `datasource: 'wh'`, where `wh` is a stored managed datasource, plus `external`, still saves (measured on this head). The spec parse sees only the object. The minimal place is the metadata-protocol object save door, calling this same predicate with the datasource it resolves, so the rule is not copied. That needs the predicate exported and is outside this card's file surface. Raised in the report as an open question.
- **Not covered here, also noted in the report:** the `composeStacks` artifact pass (it does not re-run `validateCrossReferences`); the reverse direction (saving a datasource as `managed` while objects bind it with `external`); and the `/* ... */` example in `content/docs` external-datasources §5, which should show the object's `datasource`.
- **Runtime fixtures not rewritten.** 62 fixtures in 37 test files across 12 packages hand an object with `external` and no datasource straight to a driver, the engine or a lint rule, without the parse. Those suites are green on this head. They describe a shape the parse now refuses, but they test runtime behaviour that a stored legacy row can still reach: such a row still registers under `[metadata_spec_invalid]`. They were left as they are.
- **File surface.** `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` gains 15 rows from `node scripts/check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write`, for the save-door test's engine double. It is a mechanical ledger row, as in #25181 and #25122.
- **Branch name.** The branch is the session's designated `claude/project-thread-5h4pzn`, not `claude/issue-25168-…`. The claim names it.
